description: An ordered collection that allows duplicates, usually created as an ArrayList and read by index.
A collection without duplicates, available as HashSet for speed, LinkedHashSet for insertion order and TreeSet for sorted order.
A collection of key-value pairs with unique keys, with methods such as getOrDefault, merge and computeIfAbsent.
A collection from List.of, Set.of or Map.of that throws on any change and rejects null elements.
Objects that are equal must return the same hash code, or hash-based collections cannot find them.
An object that orders elements, built from key extractors and chained with thenComparing.
A read-only wrapper that blocks changes through itself but still reflects changes made to the underlying collection.
